## Purpose

**Authoritative SorraAgents record** for the nested `node_modules` worktree symlink change. Per the producer decision on 2026-09-26, this item is the authoritative release-tracking record; the open_source_llm item **OSL-0MUFG3PJA00379CT** is the originating cross-repo record and is subordinated to this item.

## Status

**Already implemented, tested and pushed to SorraAgents `dev` in commit `763b8f11`.**

## Relationship to OSL-0MUFG3PJA00379CT

- `OSL-0MUFG3PJA00379CT` and its children — `OSL-0MUGXT9SX008CZU8` (helper + wiring), `OSL-0MUGXTVLT00236M0` (tests), `OSL-0MUGXUPMA005W5HU` (docs + full suite), `OSL-0MUI78ROQ005B37N` (cross-repo `wl` resolution) — are all `completed`/`in_review` in the open_source_llm worklog.
- Per the producer decision (2026-09-26), **this SA item is authoritative**; the OSL item is a cross-repo duplicate/companion and does not independently gate the SorraAgents release.

## What shipped

- `skill/implement/scripts/implement.py`
  - `_ensure_nested_node_modules_symlinks(worktree_path, repo_root) -> int` and `_iter_nested_node_modules(repo_root)`: bounded, best-effort discovery + symlink of nested `node_modules` (e.g. `.pi/packages/<pkg>/node_modules`) into an implement worktree, wired into `phase_start()` immediately after `_ensure_node_modules_symlink()`.
  - `wl_show` / `wl_show_children` / `wl_dep_blockers` / `wl_add_comment` / `_is_work_item_open` now use `resolve_worklog_flags(cmd)` (prefix-to-sibling) instead of `worklog_dir_flag()` (cwd chain), fixing cross-repo `OSL-*` resolution from the SorraAgents checkout.
- `tests/test_implement_nested_node_modules_symlink.py` (AC1-AC7, incl. a Node `require.resolve` check).
- `tests/test_implement_cross_repo_worklog_resolution.py` (6 regression tests).
- `skill/implement/SKILL.md` documents nested symlinks and retains the no-`npm install`-in-worktree caveat.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Nested `node_modules` symlinks created at the same relative path, resolving to the main checkout (AC2).
- [x] Existing entries never overwritten (AC3); no fabricated package dirs (AC4).
- [x] Bounded discovery: prunes `.git`/`.worklog`, never descends into `node_modules`, never follows symlinks (AC5).
- [x] Per-candidate failures are logged at WARNING, never fatal (AC6).
- [x] Root-level symlink behaviour and tests unchanged (AC1).
- [x] Dedicated helper + automated tests incl. Node resolution check (AC7).
- [x] Docs updated (AC8).
- [x] Full suite green (AC9).

## Current state / gate

- Status `blocked`; stage `plan_complete` (this repo's allowed stages: `idea`, `intake_complete`, `plan_complete`, `in_review`, `done`).
- Blocked by **SA-0MUIA3OE40001QJX** (GIT_DIR leak). The `in_review` audit fan-out must not run until that critical incident is fixed, because it can re-corrupt the live checkout and `origin/dev`.
- Advance to `in_review` once `SA-0MUIA3OE40001QJX` is fixed, so the SorraAgents release process can close it.
- `needsProducerReview` cleared on 2026-09-26 — the authority decision resolves the open question.
